name: The Dead Studio
description: A broadcast booth with the ON AIR light off and the desk still warm. Every fader is up. The monitors show a level that is not coming from anywhere. Whoever was talking stopped mid-word, and the room has the specific quality of a room that has just been listening.

objects.name: the desk
looks: Every fader up. Nothing is going anywhere.
The needles move to a voice you cannot hear.
One channel is labelled with your name, in tape, in pen, going soft.

objects.name: the ON AIR light
looks: Off. It has the look of a thing that has only just gone off.
It comes on. Nothing is being broadcast. It goes off.
There is dust on it, except where a thumb has been.

ambient: The level meters move for a while, and settle.
The headphones on the desk are producing a small, clear silence.
Somewhere down the line, a transmitter that nobody maintains keys up.
weather: The air is dead and slightly overwarm, the way a room is when the equipment has been on all night.
